headline: Lions offensive linemen Mahogany, Miller ruled out vs. Bills
summary: A pair of starters won't be playing this week for the Detroit Lions as offensive linemen Christian Mahogany (hip) and Blake Miller (knee) have been ruled out ahead of Thursday night's showdown in Buffalo.

headline: Vikings RB Jordan Mason put on IR after having surgery on thumb
summary: Vikings running back Jordan Mason was placed on injured reserve Wednesday after undergoing surgery to repair a fractured thumb.

headline: 49ers TE Jake Tonges To Undergo Season-Ending Knee Surgery
summary: The 49ers placed tight end Jake Tonges on injured reserve Wednesday. The fifth-year tight end was known to be in store for missed time as a result, but he will not return in 2026. headline: Falcons' Penix 'close' to return, still mum on Week 2 status
summary: Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. didn't rule out playing against the Panthers on Sunday but cautioned he needed to clear some benchmarks before deciding.

headline: Buccaneers' Zampese says Browns messed up by trading Mayfield
summary: Buccaneers assistant coach Ken Zampease, who was Baker Mayfield's QB coach with the Browns in 2018, says Cleveland messed up by trading the QB.

headline: Bears anticipate 'great challenge' vs. Brian Flores' Vikings defense
summary: "Coach [Ben Johnson] calls this 'mental war' when you go against versus him, and that's what it is," Bears QB Caleb Williams said of facing a Brian Flores-led defense, which Chicago will do Sunday against Minnesota.
